samples.xml_description:
<module id="calendar">
    <description>Implement a perpetual calendar with hours, minutes, and seconds.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="RST">Active high reset signal.</input>
        <output id="Hours" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current hours.</output>
        <output id="Mins" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current minutes.</output>
        <output id="Secs" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current seconds.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="Secs">Seconds counter.</parameter>
        <parameter id="Mins">Minutes counter.</parameter>
        <parameter id="Hours">Hours counter.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="Secs" type="reg">Seconds counter.</reg>
        <reg id="Mins" type="reg">Minutes counter.</reg>
        <reg id="Hours" type="reg">Hours counter.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <task id="perpetual_calendar">
            <description>Perpetual calendar logic.</description>
            <input id="CLK">Clock input.</input>
            <input id="RST">Active high reset signal.</input>
            <output id="Hours" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current hours.</output>
            <output id="Mins" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current minutes.</output>
            <output id="Secs" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current seconds.</output>
            <description>
                The perpetual calendar module continuously tracks and updates the current time in hours, minutes, and seconds. 
                It uses a clock signal (CLK) to trigger updates and a reset signal (RST) to initialize the time values to zero.
                The module increments the seconds (Secs) every clock cycle, wrapping to zero after reaching 59. 
                When seconds reach 59, it increments the minutes (Mins), wrapping to zero after reaching 59. 
                When both seconds and minutes reach 59, it increments the hours (Hours), wrapping to zero after reaching 23.
            </description>
            <if>
                <condition>
                    <operator id="RST">Reset signal is active.</operator>
                </condition>
                <then>
                    <assign id="Secs">0</assign>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <if>
                        <condition>
                            <operator id="Secs">Seconds are at maximum (59).</operator>
                        </condition>
                        <then>
                            <assign id="Secs">0</assign>
                        </then>
                        <else>
                            <assign id="Secs">Secs + 1</assign>
                        </else>
                    </if>
                </else>
            </if>
            <if>
                <condition>
                    <operator id="RST">Reset signal is active.</operator>
                </condition>
                <then>
                    <assign id="Mins">0</assign>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <if>
                        <condition>
                            <operator id="Mins">Minutes are at maximum (59).</operator>
                        </condition>
                        <then>
                            <assign id="Mins">0</assign>
                        </then>
                        <else>
                            <if>
                                <condition>
                                    <operator id="Secs">Seconds are at maximum (59).</operator>
                                </condition>
                                <then>
                                    <assign id="Mins">Mins + 1</assign>
                                </then>
                                <else>
                                    <assign id="Mins">Mins</assign>
                                </else>
                            </if>
                        </else>
                    </if>
                </else>
            </if>
            <if>
                <condition>
                    <operator id="RST">Reset signal is active.</operator>
                </condition>
                <then>
                    <assign id="Hours">0</assign>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <if>
                        <condition>
                            <operator id="Hours">Hours are at maximum (23).</operator>
                        </condition>
                        <then>
                            <assign id="Hours">0</assign>
                        </then>
                        <else>
                            <if>
                                <condition>
                                    <operator id="Secs">Seconds are at maximum (59).</operator>
                                </condition>
                                <then>
                                    <if>
                                        <condition>
                                            <operator id="Mins">Minutes are at maximum (59).</operator>
                                        </condition>
                                        <then>
                                            <assign id="Hours">Hours + 1</assign>
                                        </then>
                                        <else>
                                            <assign id="Hours">Hours</assign>
                                        </else>
                                    </if>
                                </then>
                                <else>
                                    <assign id="Hours">Hours</assign>
                                </else>
                            </if>
                        </else>
                    </if>
                </else>
            </if>
        </task>
    </implementation>
</module>
